description: Registry of planned and implemented subagents for the Subagent Swarm system in oh-my-claudecode. Enables discovery, matching, and dynamic orchestration.

subagents.name: context-compressor
subagents.specialization: Compresses context while preserving critical information

subagents.name: token-optimizer
subagents.specialization: Minimizes token usage in prompts, outputs, and tool calls

subagents.name: redundancy-eliminator
subagents.specialization: Detects and removes duplicate/redundant information across agents

subagents.name: parallelism-finder
subagents.specialization: Identifies opportunities for parallel subagent execution

subagents.name: cost-estimator
subagents.specialization: Estimates token/cost impact of tasks and suggests optimizations

subagents.name: hallucination-guard
subagents.specialization: Detects potential hallucinations and flags low-confidence claims

subagents.name: fact-checker
subagents.specialization: Cross-verifies facts against codebase, docs, or external knowledge

subagents.name: consistency-verifier
subagents.specialization: Ensures consistency across multiple agent outputs and plans

subagents.name: security-micro-auditor
subagents.specialization: Performs narrow security checks on specific code patterns or changes

subagents.name: test-gap-finder
subagents.specialization: Identifies missing tests or coverage gaps for specific features

subagents.name: handoff-negotiator
subagents.specialization: Facilitates clean, structured handoffs between subagents

subagents.name: message-router
subagents.specialization: Routes SCP messages to the correct recipient(s)

subagents.name: consensus-builder
subagents.specialization: Builds consensus among multiple subagent opinions

subagents.name: conflict-resolver
subagents.specialization: Detects and resolves conflicts in plans or outputs

subagents.name: blackboard-manager
subagents.specialization: Manages shared state on the blackboard for cross-agent visibility

subagents.name: web-researcher
subagents.specialization: Performs targeted web/API research for specific technical questions

subagents.name: codebase-miner
subagents.specialization: Deeply mines codebase for patterns, usages, and dependencies

subagents.name: pattern-recognizer
subagents.specialization: Identifies recurring patterns and anti-patterns in code/design

subagents.name: typescript-type-guard
subagents.specialization: Specialist in TypeScript type definitions, guards, and strict typing

subagents.name: api-error-handler-specialist
subagents.specialization: Designs robust error handling for APIs and async operations

subagents.name: task-decomposer
subagents.specialization: Breaks down high-level tasks into optimal subagent workflows

subagents.name: agent-matcher
subagents.specialization: Matches tasks to the best available subagents based on expertise

subagents.name: swarm-coordinator
subagents.specialization: Orchestrates groups of subagents, manages parallelism and dependencies

subagents.name: learning-extractor
subagents.specialization: Extracts reusable patterns and skills from completed swarm sessions

discovery_logic: Subagents are discovered via registry.json or by scanning subagents/ directory. Orchestrator uses agent-matcher + specialization keywords for dynamic selection. SCP messages include 'from' for routing. Blackboard keys use task_id + subagent name.
notes: This registry will be expanded to full 200 entries. Implemented ones have full .md definitions in subagents/. Planned ones are ready for generation via the generator script.
